code_checks.subject: Actual full parent runs and exact byte qualification
code_checks.reason: Three raw logs and manifests were inspected, not replaced by summaries or earlier verdicts. Closing seven file hashes independently match their tested hashes. S4/S5 full parents pass, five complete serial files include six parents and 63 reported tests with zero failures/skips. No name filter, added skip/focus, timeout relaxation or assertion deletion appears in the reviewed diffs. Source55ba/ce8 and gateway fixture be9 remain unchanged.

findings.title: Manifest overstates absence of a development grant
findings.actual_claim: Inert FK-only Bindings retain no Authorization/development grant; no full-authority fixture adapter was added.
findings.evidence: imprint-development-organization-db.test.mjs retains the c915 baseline INSERT into development_grants_v14 with read, EXISTING_ONLY, FIXED_AT_GRANT, freeze cursor 1, fields ['public'] and one-hour expiry. It is inserted after the newly added initial zero-grant assertion and used by direct-admin development_visible_record_v14 filter tests.
findings.impact: The code repair does not introduce an authenticated or broader grant, but the manifest wording can be read as claiming no grant exists throughout the run. That claim exceeds the actual evidence.
findings.required_change: Correct this one metadata statement to distinguish initially ungranted actor/holders, the unchanged original constrained filter-only development grant, and the absence of any new general raw/authenticated/full grant. Preserve the existing limited fixture and all tests.
findings.resolution_boundary: Read and hash the corrected manifest, preserve this original finding/report in the evidence archive, then issue a bounded independent PASS. No source/test change or PostgreSQL rerun is needed.

qualification_limits: This is independent review of the seven fixture changes and their three exact local execution evidence sets.
No older serialization ea3 or r2 Source PASS was borrowed; only current55ba/ce8 bytes and affected protocol implementation were used.
Reported Node tests aggregate 65 across three commands; the count is not a claim of 65 newly added scenarios.
No new-head CI admission, merge, deployment, real browser eight-view acceptance or Stage 3 completion is approved or claimed.
This review neither diagnoses shared runner Git-fetch failures as disk failures nor bypasses the pending shared-path main landing.
